# Shaw's Pest Control – Wichita, KS

> Wichita-area pest control specialists protecting homes and businesses from ants, spiders, roaches, bed bugs, termites, and mosquitoes across south-central Kansas. Licensed technicians, proven treatments, and straightforward pricing.

## Homepage
URL: https://shawspest.com/

Shaw's Pest Control is Wichita's trusted pest management solution for homeowners and businesses throughout south-central Kansas. Our licensed technicians handle everything from recurring general pest control to one-time termite treatments and seasonal mosquito programs. Fast scheduling, honest pricing, and treatments that work.

## General Pest Control
URL: https://shawspest.com/pestcontrol/

Comprehensive interior and exterior pest control for homes and businesses. Covers common Kansas pests including ants, spiders, roaches, silverfish, earwigs, and more. Available as one-time or recurring service plans.

## Ant Control
URL: https://shawspest.com/pest-control-ants/

Targeted ant elimination and prevention treatments. We identify the ant species and apply the appropriate treatment to eliminate the colony — not just the ants you can see.

## Spider Control
URL: https://shawspest.com/pest-control-spiders/

Spider removal and prevention for homes and businesses. Treatment focuses on entry points, harborage areas, and eliminating the insect prey that attracts spiders.

## Roach Control
URL: https://shawspest.com/pest-control-roaches/

German and American cockroach elimination programs. Includes gel bait, insect growth regulator application, and follow-up treatments as needed until the infestation is resolved.

## Bed Bug Treatment
URL: https://shawspest.com/pest-control-bedbugs/

Professional bed bug inspection and treatment. Options include chemical treatment and heat treatment for complete elimination with minimal disruption.

## Termite Control
URL: https://shawspest.com/termites/

Termite inspection, treatment, and prevention for Kansas homes. We treat active infestations and install baiting or liquid barrier systems to protect against future colonies.

## Mosquito Control
URL: https://shawspest.com/mosquito-control/

Seasonal mosquito reduction programs for residential yards and commercial outdoor spaces. Barrier spray treatments applied on a recurring schedule through mosquito season.

## Service Areas
Wichita, Andover, Augusta, Derby, El Dorado, Newton, Hutchinson, Wellington, Winfield, Arkansas City, and surrounding south-central Kansas
